413-1778-5006-8170.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Memnite spell. When Memnite enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Memnite, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1116-4279-6578--216.easyPrerequisites:
You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1116-4279-6578--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth, Sek'Kuar and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar ability, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token with haste.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

206-4289-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

245-560-2034.description:
Activate Marneus by paying {6}, creating four creature tokens due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
When the tokens enter, Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three creature tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-3249-4549-7968--206.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4549-7968--206.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Relic of Legends's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the zombie castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that zombie spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that zombie or when it enters, Diregraf Colossus triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

339-677-728-969.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

670-1619-3175-4681-5231.easyPrerequisites: Sefris' first ability hasn't triggered this turn.
670-1619-3175-4681-5231.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in the second to last room of any dungeon.
670-1619-3175-4681-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Sefris' first ability triggers, causing you to venture into the final room of a dungeon, causing you to complete the dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Sefris and Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sefris trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into the Cave Entrace room, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into either available room.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Sefris from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sefris enters, Radiant Solar triggers, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into any available room.
Repeat.
670-1619-3175-4681-5231.notes: You may instead execute this combo by venturing into Tomb of Annihilation instead of Lost Mine of Phandelver.

913-1170-2440-7517.description:
Cast the copy of Aqueous Aria spell from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Campus Composer, which enters prepared.
When Campus Composer enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}.
Resolve the spell from step 1, creating a 3/3 Elemental creature token with flying.
When the token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Pay an additional {2}{U} to repeat steps 1 through 5 an additional time, this time adding {C}{C}{C} from the Mana Echoes triggers.
Pay an additional {1}{U} to repeat the loop again, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {U} to repeat the loop again, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {U} to repeat the loop again, adding six {C}.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat steps 1 through 5 and step 10 any number of times.
913-1170-2440-7517.notes: Mana needed drops significantly for each additional Merfolk, Bard, and Elemental you control.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

575-4294-5147-7115.description:
Cast Etali either from your hand or the command zone by paying {5}{R}{R} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Etali enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Yedora triggers, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Holding priority, activate Etali by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, exiling cards from the top of each library until each player has exiled a nonland card, and causing you to cast any number of those cards without paying its mana cost.
For each card cast, Toph's second ability triggers once.
Resolve the first Toph trigger, earthbending Etali.
Resolve any remaining triggers, earthbending any other lands you desire. If you do not want to earthbend other lands, target Etali with all remaining triggers.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Toph and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, choosing not to return Etali.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 11.

2438-7084-7201.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

116-4785-7163.easyPrerequisites: You are able to put a triggered ability on the stack.
116-4785-7163.description:
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Dynaheir by tapping it.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, targeting the ability from step 1.
Dynaheir triggers. Holding priority, activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Dynaheir's trigger twice
Resolve the first copy of Dynaheir's trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting Dynaheir's trigger
Resolve the copy of Mister Fantastic's ability, copying Dynaheir's trigger twice.
Repeat from step 6

2034-4871-5496-6632-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to The Water Crystal.
Repeat.

323-2034-5170-6132.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4365-5524-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4365-5524-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Destiny Spinner
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

338-3490-3641-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-3641-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1379-1978-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
1379-1978-3443.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat

2173-3661-5220-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2034-4375-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

2558-5687-5690-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Ruination Guide, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.

Resolve the Woe Strider ability.

3259-6633--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6633--95.notes: If you choose a creature with mobilize 2 or higher, this combo makes extra Warrior tokens each loop.

955-1563-2457-3129.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-4871-6291.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1753-5470-6188.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
1753-5470-6188.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

372-961-4125.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Against All Odds exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-961-4125.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Shipwreck Dowser and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Shipwreck Dowser trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Against All Odds.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Shipwreck Dowser and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1526-1909-4486.notablePrerequisites: Circle of Dreams Druid does not have summoning sickness.
1526-1909-4486.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Repeat.
1526-1909-4486.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

1322-2933-4013-5798.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

2267-4798-5436-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2267-4798-5436-5686.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-1295-1368-5399--39.notablePrerequisites: Pirated Copy is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-1295-1368-5399--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Pirated Copy trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

184-1308-3883.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
184-1308-3883.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing you to draw a card and create two Treasure artifact tokens for each opponent you have.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
If you have three or more opponents, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

880-3470-3678.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

228-549-4853-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure token, creating two 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to a Construct token.
The Construct dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Skullclamp and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.

643-876-2525-4302-4951.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least four.
643-876-2525-4302-4951.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Priest of Fell Rites.
Activate Priest of Fell Rites by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it.
When Priest of Fell Rites dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Resolve the Priest of Fell Rites ability, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Priest of Fell Rites.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Body Double.
Activate Body Double by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it.
 When Body Double dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Resolve the Body Double ability, returning Priest of Fell Rites from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Fell Rites enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Repeat.

2191-4944.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting any creature you control.
Activate the creature by paying {0}.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

3096-4267.notablePrerequisites:
Divining Witch does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
3096-4267.description:
Activate Divining Witch by paying {1}{B}, tapping it and discarding a card, naming Divining Witch and exiling your library due to it not containing a card named Divining Witch.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing target player to mill two cards and you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

1295-4772-5305.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is equal to or greater than the number of cards in hand minus two.
1295-4772-5305.description:
Cast Mordenkainen by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Mordenkainen enters the battlefield with ten loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Activate Mordenkainen's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it.
Mordenkainen dies as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Mordenkainen ability, exchanging your hand and library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

632-2178-4050-4242.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Scarecrone.
Scarecrone does not have summoning sickness.
632-2178-4050-4242.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding one mana of any color.
Su-Chi dies, triggering itself and Scarecrone.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Scarecrone trigger, untapping it.
Activate Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

411-1283-3593.description:
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {1} and returning it to your hand, adding {3}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {1}, putting Grinning Ignus from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
